display_name: 36. 저해상도 이득 지도 기반 세부정보 주입 제한
phase: 0 (no training): Ga classical MTF-GLP vs A0 on RR20/FR20; Gb oracle ceiling of the constrained output on validation
reference_source: DLPan-Toolbox a34f884: GLP/MTF_GLP.m, Tools/LPfilterGauss.m, Tools/genMTF.m, Tools/MTF_PAN.m, Tools/interp23tap.m (read only, reimplemented in Python)

mtf_glp.input_ms: H5 LMS (upsampled MS), as MTF_GLP(I_MS, I_PAN, 'QB', 4) receives
mtf_glp.histogram_matching: PAN_eq_b = (PAN - mean2(PAN)) * std2(LMS_b) / std2(LPfilterGauss(PAN)) + mean2(LMS_b); std2 with N-1
mtf_glp.LPfilterGauss: GNyq 0.3, N 41, alpha uses N*(fcut/2) (not N-1), Kaiser fwind1, replicate
mtf_glp.PAN_LP_b: interp23tap(nearest decimation by 4 of imfilter(PAN_eq_b, genMTF_QB_band_b, replicate)), phase 2

Ga.compare: MTF-GLP vs A0 (experiment SSAI 4 archived per-scene RR/FR) with the same common/metrics.py
Ga.pass: MTF-GLP FR mean D_s <= A0 FR mean D_s - 0.005
Ga.fail_action: premise 'constrained injection lowers D_s' is weak; do not train plan B

bases.LPr: interp23tap(phase-correct decimation by r of MTF_PAN-style filter at ratio r)

fits: K1: one gain on D1+D2 per band per cell
K2: gains on D1 and D2 per band per cell
Gb.oracle: per band, per cell least squares with GT (upper bound, not achievable)
Gb.null: same fit with the neighbouring patch's PAN (chance fit)
Gb.A0_reference: 1 - E_A/E_LMS on the same validation patches
Gb.pass: K2 cell4 (oracle - null) >= A0 explained fraction
Gb.fail_action: strict P1 cannot reach A0 RR even ideally; drop P1 and centre phase 1 on P3-W
